assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: premium mobile wallpaper preview, portrait 1080 x 2400, 9:20 aspect ratio.
Primary request: Create an exquisite editorial automotive and botanical collage, designed as a real phone wallpaper.
Scene/backdrop: opaque full bleed pale blush pink, immaculate subtle matte paper texture.
Subject: a photorealistic blush pink Porsche 911 inspired widebody sports coupe seen from a low rear three-quarter angle, beautiful real automotive proportions, exquisite paint and wheel detail. It enters from the lower left and occupies the bottom 28 percent, cropped naturally by left and bottom edges. One delicate realistic pink hibiscus flower rests near the upper-left perimeter, refined translucent petal veins, not oversized.
Composition/framing: elegantly spare magazine art direction; the center and most upper area are generous uninterrupted quiet pale blush negative space for a future schedule and clock. Balanced intentional scale, crisply isolated subject edges without sticker outlines. Car entirely below the central schedule area.
Lighting/mood: soft luminous studio highlights, calm elegant and aspirational.
Color palette: blush pink, soft rose, pale pink, restrained charcoal mechanical accents.
Constraints: portrait canvas oriented upright, opaque artwork only, no typography or lettering anywhere, no brand badges, no logos, no slogans, no schedule, no UI, no phone or device frame, no border, no watermark, no extra objects, no street scene.

Use case: stylized-concept

Constraints: upright tall portrait canvas, opaque full bleed artwork only, no typography, text, lettering, logos, badges, slogans, schedule, UI, phone frame, border, watermark or extra decorative objects.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: premium mobile wallpaper preview, portrait 1080 x 2400, 9:20 aspect ratio.
Primary request: Create an exceptionally tasteful dramatic editorial sports-car phone wallpaper.
Scene/backdrop: opaque full bleed rich crimson red matte paper with very fine subtle grain, even and uncluttered.
Subject: photorealistic dark cherry Porsche GT3 inspired sports car rear quarter with sculptural rear wing, continuous slim rear lights, beautiful precise bodywork, black diffuser and understated exhaust detail. Low rear three-quarter camera angle. The car enters from lower left, naturally cropped by left and bottom edges, occupying only the bottom 29 percent. Realistic immaculate automotive construction, no readable branding.
Composition/framing: striking minimalist automotive campaign art direction, a large expanse of quiet uninterrupted crimson through the center and upper canvas for a future timetable and phone clock. Beautiful confident negative space, car anchored along bottom-left with subtle depth, no flowers or other objects.
Lighting/mood: dramatic refined studio highlights trace dark cherry curves, rich yet visible shadow detail, luxurious cinematic restraint.
Color palette: rich crimson backdrop, deep cherry paint, near-black carbon details, narrow restrained silver-white reflections.
Constraints: upright tall portrait canvas, no text or typography of any kind, no logos or brand badges, no slogans, no flowers, no schedule, no UI, no device frame, no borders, no watermark. Artwork only.
